summary: @or-sdk/chat 0.3.2 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it, and uses the freshly-installed Bun binary to execute the sibling file math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` script whose contents are a rotating string-array dispatcher with an XOR-style decoder (identifiers WV8StW / n7gIxM / MmgoCP) — its behavior is not readable from static text. The advertised purpose of the package is a small browser chat-window helper (~50 lines of TypeScript in src/), which has no need for the Bun runtime or a 727KB opaque payload at install time. The preinstall alternate-runtime dropper fires automatically on `npm install`, running attacker-supplied code under the Bun runtime and bypassing Node-based install-time inspection. The mismatch between the tiny published SDK source and the bundled obfuscated Bun payload is consistent with a compromised release rather than a legitimate build artifact.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
